restrained-satire.voice_reason: Like ref.md, Z lets judgment come from flat juxtaposition, the institution's own speech and a closing physical image (the letter passed from window to guard to clerk, the director's '反正是了解了', the polish ring mopped away), while W keeps stepping in to explain its ironies ('唯一诚实的一个', '唯一没有人检查的东西') and ends on a product-design aphorism.
